component.name: X7 Control
component.summary: Sound Blaster X7 settings on Linux

description.p: X7 Control talks to a Creative Sound Blaster X7 over Bluetooth and exposes every setting the discontinued phone app had: output routing, master volume and mute, SBX Pro Studio effects, the box's 10-band equalizer, CrystalVoice microphone processing and the firmware switches.
On the PC side it manages a PipeWire headphone-correction EQ (with AutoEq import), an optional HRTF 7.1 game-surround sink and an RNNoise voice-only microphone filter.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Creative Technology Ltd.
New Outputs page: name every output, set volume and format, and give each one its own parametric EQ with a live response curve. Voice filter moved to the Mic page.
Live frequency-response graphs, plain-language descriptions of every band and a short equalizer primer on both EQ pages.
